queries.FL_Tdocs: SELECT node_id,tdocNumber,title,summaryType FROM Tdoc WHERE summaryType='FL' ORDER BY node_id
queries.AgendaItems: SELECT * FROM AgendaItem ORDER BY node_id
queries.Companies: SELECT * FROM Company ORDER BY node_id
queries.BELONGS_TO: SELECT e.edge_id,e.src_id,e.dst_id FROM edge e JOIN Tdoc t ON t.node_id=e.src_id WHERE t.summaryType='FL' AND e.rel_type='BELONGS_TO' ORDER BY e.edge_id
queries.MODERATED_BY: SELECT e.edge_id,e.src_id,e.dst_id FROM edge e JOIN Tdoc t ON t.node_id=e.src_id WHERE t.summaryType='FL' AND e.rel_type='MODERATED_BY' ORDER BY e.edge_id

full_path_query:
SELECT t.node_id,t.tdocNumber,t.title,t.summaryType,ai.node_id agenda_node_id,
ai.meetingNumber,ai.agendaNumber,ai.agendaDescription,c.node_id company_node_id,c.companyName
FROM Tdoc t JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO b ON b.src_id=t.node_id JOIN AgendaItem ai ON ai.node_id=b.dst_id
JOIN rel_MODERATED_BY mo ON mo.src_id=t.node_id JOIN Company c ON c.node_id=mo.dst_id
WHERE t.summaryType='FL' ORDER BY ai.meetingNumber,ai.agendaNumber,t.tdocNumber,c.companyName
